name: kids-book-gen-studio
description: Create and review emotionally engaging, developmentally appropriate children's books.

interface.shortDescription: Create thoughtful picture-book stories for young children.
interface.longDescription: Create developmentally appropriate children's-book stories through character purpose, emotion, agency, and natural consequences. The first release packages the preschool behavior-story workflow and does not require a server connection.
defaultPrompt: Create a gentle preschool story about taking turns.
Help me turn a behavior goal into a picture-book story.
Write a 12-spread read-aloud for a four-year-old.
